scripts/windows_skill_system_deps.ps1

PowerShell · Tier B

Provision native Windows skill clients through WinGet.

Usage

Dot-source from the Windows Gateway installer, then call Install-SkillSystemDeps.

Inputs

Existing system-dependency skip flags and available native tools on PATH.

Side effects

Installs missing clients and updates this process's PATH; WinGet verifies hashes.

Cleanup

Optional client errors are reported and setup continues; no services or accounts are configured or restarted.
